tdd_anchor: Scaffold tasks have no feature AC. RED = does not boot / tooling does not run; GREEN = boot + empty suite + migration apply/revert all succeed.

tasks.title: Create backend/ layout with uv + Python 3.14, app entry point, config, and a /health endpoint
tasks.dod: `uv run` boots the API locally; GET /health returns 200; backend/app/ has core/ and main.py per map § Module layout; settings load from .env via pydantic-settings

tasks.title: Wire pytest with a boot smoke test and an integration fixture on a real Postgres + pgvector container
tasks.dod: pytest runs green; the boot smoke test hits /health; an integration test opens a session on a real pgvector Postgres and runs SELECT 1

tasks.title: Set up Alembic + an initial migration: pgvector extension, users, api_keys (UUID v7 keys, user_id invariant)
tasks.dod: the migration upgrades, downgrades and upgrades again cleanly on a fresh Postgres 18 + pgvector; file name follows YYYYMMDD_HHMM_<what>.py

tasks.title: Compose file for local dev: API, worker placeholder (same image, other command), Postgres 18 + pgvector
tasks.dod: `docker compose up` boots the stack; the worker placeholder starts and idles; S2 and S3 pass against the compose Postgres

tasks.title: API-key auth: X-API-Key dependency checking SHA-256 hashes in api_keys, and a create-key CLI command
tasks.dod: an authenticated test endpoint returns 401 without a key, 401 with a wrong key, 200 with a key from `create-key --user <name>`; only the hash is stored; /health stays public

tasks.title: Structured JSON logging and the error envelope
tasks.dod: logs are one JSON object per line; any API error, including validation and 404, returns {"error": {"code", "message"}} with the right status; tested

tasks.title: One local check command `uv run poe check`: ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy --strict, pytest, migration round-trip
tasks.dod: one command runs every part and exits non-zero on any failure; it passes on the current tree

tasks.title: CI: GitHub Actions runs `uv run poe check` on every PR with a Postgres + pgvector service container
tasks.dod: a PR to main shows the check job; it runs the same command as local and fails the PR when the command fails

tasks.title: Production compose (Caddy + API + worker + Postgres), deploy/deploy.sh over SSH, nightly pg_dump cron on the server
tasks.dod: `docker compose -f deploy/compose.prod.yaml config` validates; deploy.sh does git pull, compose up -d --build, alembic upgrade head; the backup script writes a dated dump locally and is tested against the dev stack. The first real deploy waits for a domain (map § Open)

tasks.title: Update CLAUDE.md (short Stack section pointing at the map, fill Commands) and .env.example
tasks.dod: CLAUDE.md matches docs/architecture-map.md; Commands lists run, test, check, migrate, create-key, deploy; .env.example lists every variable read by the settings
